prompt: Our UIKit delivery-options table supports iOS 26 and later. Each row has an option name and a short status. Long translated names get cut off at large text sizes, and we currently distinguish the chosen option only by color. A row can be configured again for a different option without a reuse callback. Show a focused cell and table configuration, plus unit tests, that preserves the text and makes chosen versus unchosen state understandable. The caller supplies localized strings and the current chosen state; selection handling and persistence already live in the controller. Explain what your unit tests establish and what they cannot establish.
